questionText:
Identify the ONE CORRECT matching between the OSI layers and their corresponding functionalities as shown.

OSI LayersFunctionalities
(a) Network layer(I) Packet routing
(b) Transport layer(II) Framing and error handling
(c) Datalink layer(III) Host to host communication
explanation:
To find the correct matching:

1. Network Layer (a): Responsible for routing packets across network boundaries (Packet routing). Thus, (a) matches with (I).

2. Transport Layer (b): Responsible for process-to-process communication, end-to-end delivery, or host-to-host delivery/communication mechanisms depending on context. Here, (b) matches with (III).

3. Datalink Layer (c): Responsible for node-to-node framing, media access, and error handling. Thus, (c) matches with (II).

Correct Matching: (a)-(I), (b)-(III), (c)-(II).
